title: The history of chocolate
instructions: Bir müze rehberi çikolatanın tarihini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; tarihler, yerler ve sıralamaya dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Welcome to the Chocolate Museum. Let me tell you a little about the history of chocolate.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Chocolate comes from the cacao tree, which grows in hot countries.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: More than three thousand years ago, people in Central America made a drink from cacao beans.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: But it wasn't sweet. It was bitter, and they often added chilli!

script.speaker: guide
script.text: In the sixteenth century, the Spanish brought cacao to Europe. They added sugar, and the drink became very popular with rich people.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: For a long time, chocolate was only a drink. The first chocolate bar was made in England in eighteen forty-seven.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Milk chocolate came later, from Switzerland, in eighteen seventy-five.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Today, most cacao comes from West Africa, especially Ivory Coast and Ghana.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: At the end of the tour, you can make your own chocolate in our kitchen.
